issue.title: Make agent launches ride out a busy agent artifact index
issue.description: A detached agent runner survives a transiently busy agent artifact index or dismissed-bundle index instead of failing its launch, while hot callers keep bounded single-attempt lookups, fail-closed semantics hold, runner failure hints are typed and honest, and the next busy failure names its SQLite lock class.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/launch_lookup_busy_resilience.md requests this work

issue.title: Opt-in busy patience at the lookup facades, installed by the agent runner
issue.description: runner-lookup-patience: add a process-wide LookupPatience policy and retry_while_busy helper, wrap the artifact and dismissed-bundle lookup facades so busy-incomplete results retry with capped backoff under patience, install it in the agent runner entry with concise retry log lines, and test the default single-attempt path stays unchanged.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/launch_lookup_busy_resilience.md defines phase runner-lookup-patience as one work unit

issue.title: Typed host lookup failures, provider-retry exclusion, honest runner hint
issue.description: typed-transient-classification: add an IndexLookupUnavailable base with a transient flag for both lookup exceptions, exclude host lookup failures from provider retry via is_host_owned_failure, and make record_runner_error print a typed transient or index-repair hint instead of the coincidental provider match.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/launch_lookup_busy_resilience.md defines phase typed-transient-classification as one work unit

issue.title: SQLite extended codes in sase-core busy lookup diagnostics
issue.description: busy-diagnostics: in sase-core, decorate busy/locked SQLite errors on the artifact-index and dismissed-bundle lookup read paths with the extended code, keeping busy classification, wire shapes, and bindings unchanged.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/launch_lookup_busy_resilience.md defines phase busy-diagnostics as one work unit
